A major release: Forge Desk publishes its image to `ghcr.io/brunoorsolon/forge-desk`. Use this image path when you upgrade; the previous image package is no longer available.

## Breaking

- **New image path.** Pull `ghcr.io/brunoorsolon/forge-desk:3`, or pin `3.0.0`. The repository is [github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk).
- **CLI command.** The CLI is installed only as `forge-desk`; update scripts and systemd units to call it. The Docker image's entrypoint is unaffected.
- **Theme and line mode reset once.** The web UI reads only its `forge-desk:*` browser keys, so it does not pick up a theme or line mode that 2.x saved. Choose them again after the upgrade.

## Changed

- **Tracker `User-Agent`.** GitHub and Gitea requests send `User-Agent: forge-desk`.
- **DOT export graph id.** DOT exports start with `digraph "forge-desk"`.
- **Server log line.** Startup logs `forge-desk listening on ...`.
- **Compose service and container.** `docker-compose.yml` names the service and the container `forge-desk`.
- **Help name.** Help and usage say `forge-desk`.

## New

- **Release publication (opt-in).** Forge Desk can push one approved annotated tag and create one stable Gitea release, with a private state volume, a login and dedicated credentials. A planning-only deployment needs none of it. Guide: [docs/RELEASES.md](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk/blob/main/docs/RELEASES.md).

## Upgrading from 2.0.5

Config syntax, `EV_*` variables, API paths, shared planning URLs, planning login and export formats (apart from the DOT graph id) are unchanged. Change the image path. If you switch to compose files with a different container name, stop and remove the previous container before `docker compose up -d` so it releases the port; preserve your config, `.env` and mounted data. Update anything that matches the old `User-Agent`, DOT graph id or log line, and update any copied agent skill to `skills/forge-desk-issues/`. Step by step: [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](https://github.com/brunoorsolon/forge-desk/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md#upgrading).
